articles.title: India's warship-building capability gaining new speed in modern technology: Navy Chief
articles.summary: Chief of Naval Staff Admiral Krishna Swaminathan announced the Sunday commissioning of three frontline platforms for the Indian Navy. These include INS Dunagiri, an advanced stealth frigate, and INS Sanshodhak, alongside a third vessel. This significant induction enhances India's naval capabilities and reinforces its maritime defence readiness, marking a crucial step in modernizing the fleet with advanced indigenous assets.

articles.title: PM Modi delays airport departure to ease traffic for NEET-UG re-examination students
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi delayed his departure from Delhi airport on Sunday. This decision was made to prevent traffic congestion, specifically to ensure students heading to the NEET-UG 2026 re-examination faced no disruptions. The PM's thoughtful gesture prioritized public convenience and student welfare, allowing thousands of aspirants to reach their exam centers without hindrance, demonstrating responsive governance.

articles.title: India does not want to remain merely a buyer in defence sector, it seeks to become a major manufacturer, says Prime Minister Narendra Modi
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced India's strategic shift from a mere defence buyer to a major global manufacturer and decisive player in the sector. He emphasized boosting domestic production and reducing import dependency to enhance self-reliance. This move aims to strengthen India's defence industrial base and contribute significantly to global defence capabilities, underscoring the nation's ambition for self-sufficiency.
